view.label: View
view.trigger: View options — zoom {zoom}, page width, source numbers
noAccess.title: This document isn’t available
noAccess.body: It may have been deleted, or it isn’t shared with you.
noAccess.failed: Your request didn’t get through. Check your connection and try again.
ended.revoked: You no longer have access to this document

ended.bodyDatabase: It stays on screen until you leave.
ended.copyFailed: Couldn’t copy the text. Select it and copy it yourself.
leaveUnsent.title: Leave without your latest changes?
leaveUnsent.body: They haven’t reached the node yet. Stay on this page and they’re sent when the connection is back.
trashed.title: This document is in Trash
trashed.body: No one can edit it there. Items in Trash are deleted permanently after {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.
lockedHint: This document is locked. Its owner or an admin can unlock it.
outline.title: Outline

presence.noCursor: {name} doesn’t have a cursor in this document right now.

comments.noneNote: Select text in the document to comment on it.
comments.generalPlaceholder: Add a general comment… Type @ to mention someone
comments.deleteReplyBody: The reply is removed for everyone. This can’t be undone.
comments.deleteThreadTitle: Delete this comment and its {count, plural, one {# reply} other {# replies}}?
comments.deleteThreadBody: Deleting the first comment in a thread removes the whole thread for everyone. This can’t be undone.
comments.deleteCommentBody: The comment is removed for everyone. This can’t be undone.
mentions.label: Mention someone
mentions.noReaderMatch: No one who can open this document matches “{query}”
mentions.nobody: No one else can open this document yet

versions.restoredBy: {name} restored the version from {version}. The text before it is kept in Versions.
versions.restoredByYou: Restored the version from {version}. The text before it is kept in Versions.
versions.noChangeTitleSized: No characters added or removed · {count, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}} in this version

versions.restoreGone: Restore failed. That version is no longer available.
versions.deleteForbidden: Delete failed. Only the owner or a workspace admin can delete a version.

versions.deleteGone: Delete failed. That version is no longer available.
versions.behind: The document has changed since this was shown
versions.identicalToCurrent: No differences — this version is identical to the current document.

versions.confirmDeleteUnnamed: Delete this version permanently? The document itself is unchanged.
versions.cannotDeleteCurrent: The current version can’t be deleted
versions.deleteHint: Remove this version from the history
